steps.prompt_exact: I need a tiny phone-friendly browser tool I can save as one HTML file: paste a batch of page titles, URLs, and topics, then have it score orphan or underlinked pages, suggest internal links and anchor text, and let me copy or export the rescue plan.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a complete self-contained HTML internal-link rescue board with paste input, local scoring, orphan and underlinked flags, editable anchor suggestions, copy/export/download/print controls, sample data, localStorage, and responsive CSS.
code_blocks:
Internal Link Rescue Board

Paste pages, score orphan or underlinked risk, then generate source pages, target pages, anchor text, and a copyable rescue plan.

Accepted formats: pipe, tab, or CSV. Best fields are title, URL, topic, inlinks, outlinks. Inlinks can be blank if unknown.
This tool does not crawl your site. It uses pasted counts and page similarity to create a practical internal-link rescue plan.
